svg.text: L3 Lab — Multi-Area OSPF Enterprise Network
Two OSPF areas (Office / Warehouse) over an Area 0 backbone; redundant NAT edges; centralized DHCP relay; native VLAN 99 on all trunks.
All values read from the device running-configs. Cabling/interfaces from the links list; addressing, areas, VLANs, NAT, DHCP from each config. SVI = default gateway .1 per subnet.
